name: SearchPeopleFree

search.notes: No site URL pattern was confirmed, so search Google for the name on this domain and open the listing in a browser.

steps: Open the opt-out page, enter first name, last name and email and complete the captcha yourself.
Open the emailed link within 24 hours.
Search for the record within 30 minutes and remove it.
optout.notes: The page says the removal session lasts 30 minutes and to allow 3 days. Operated by Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC per the 2026 California registry, along with FastPeopleSearch, USPhonebook, SearchPeopleFree, SmartBackgroundChecks, CyberBackgroundChecks and AdvancedBackgroundChecks. Each site has its own opt-out.

sources.attribution: California Privacy Protection Agency data broker registry, 2026 list fetched 2026-10-27

verification_note: Opt-out page loaded on 2026-10-27 and uses a Turnstile captcha. Search pages served a Cloudflare challenge.
